name: Sunhallow
subtitle: Fire over Sunhallow
author: Luminati
description: The start of Vanquish the Evil Dragon: a village of adobe and sandstone at the foot of the Wyrmspine, at noon, burning — seven monster packs at its houses, a dragon's shadow in the sky. Generated by tools/make-vanquish-the-evil-dragon.mjs.

objects.name: The Granary
text: The granary door is split down the middle. Sacks of grain spill into the street.

objects.name: The Smithy
text: Heat pours out of the smithy. The forge fire has spread to the rafters.

objects.name: Temple of the Dawn
text: The temple doors are barred from within. Someone inside is praying, loudly.

objects.name: Merchant Hall
text: The merchant hall is locked. Through a crack: bolts of cloth, untouched.

objects.name: The Sun & Sickle
text: The Sun & Sickle. The shutters are torn off and the sign is smoking.

objects.name: Elder Hesk's House
text: Elder Hesk's house. The door is shut tight; the roof has held.
The water is low and full of ash. It will clear.

objects.name: Tobin
talk: Tobin: They're gone. And my forge still stands. I owe you a sword, friend. #line:F1B1682A3002094D67395231AC3F3F96
Tobin: Hounds in my forge! Burning hounds! Get them out — I've only a hammer! #line:D0C712006873D4B57ACFDF9D5CC84C11

objects.name: Old Marta
talk: Old Marta: Seventy years in this village. Never seen the like. Thank you, dear. #line:426B271AFF9F3D0C4D6B804808ECABD2
Old Marta: Robed devils, throwing fire at my inn! Don't just stand there — go! #line:F116AE29D7523082A1C4899788432166

objects.name: Old Marta
talk: Old Marta: Seventy years in this village. Never seen the like. Thank you, dear. #line:6CF4459423679641DA362FF1BB5EA1A2

objects.name: Pell
talk: Pell: My mama said hide. I'm hiding! Is this good hiding? #line:78A33C6D8C54A25ADECF247C3DDB58EB

objects.name: Pell
talk: Pell: Are they really all gone? Even the big horned ones? #line:BA6E65E01987013C9A8C7949808E42A4

objects.name: Sefa
talk: Sefa: The water's all ash! We can't put anything out! #line:3223AFF0712B5BA9D616C1431EFDBC05

objects.name: Sefa
talk: Sefa: The baker's oven held. Bread tomorrow — I swear it! #line:66976960181302173DC81898C8E65301

objects.name: Old Joss
talk: Old Joss: The granary — a whole winter's grain in there. Please! #line:620E71AF21DDB2DDCF5A0977BC315AFA

objects.name: Old Joss
talk: Old Joss: The granary held. A whole winter's grain, saved by strangers. #line:A84F31109084A15AC1B7B5EC9528AE8F

objects.name: Rina
talk: Rina: The temple — the sisters are still inside! #line:5590F926E8AA671DF356AE9590E53553

objects.name: Rina
talk: Rina: The sisters are safe. The temple bell will ring for you tonight. #line:0EA53F7DD2C0816F727D26B74C229BF3

objects.name: Corwin
talk: Corwin: Those horned brutes came down the pass road. The pass road! #line:0ABC0F74EB39E5325BC45EB1A4F4A599

objects.name: Corwin
talk: Corwin: I watched its shadow fly north. Toward the Throne. #line:1B6F11BF22C4B2D432C9E8F5CDBE385D

objects.name: Villager
dialogue: We're alive… thanks to you. All of us, thanks to you.
